tokens.name: n-50
tokens.usage: Lightest neutral. Rarely used; highlights on the light ground.

tokens.name: n-100
tokens.usage: Light theme ground (bg). Dark theme ink.

tokens.name: n-150
tokens.usage: Dark theme fog dots.

tokens.name: n-200
tokens.usage: Neutral step. A grey with a slight red bias (hue 25), so the neutrals belong to the seal. One scale serves both themes.

tokens.name: n-300
tokens.usage: Light theme hairlines (line).

tokens.name: n-400
tokens.usage: Neutral step. A grey with a slight red bias (hue 25), so the neutrals belong to the seal. One scale serves both themes.

tokens.name: n-500
tokens.usage: Dark theme secondary text (ink-soft).

tokens.name: n-600
tokens.usage: Light theme secondary text (ink-soft).

tokens.name: n-700
tokens.usage: Neutral step. A grey with a slight red bias (hue 25), so the neutrals belong to the seal. One scale serves both themes.

tokens.name: n-800
tokens.usage: Dark theme hairlines (line).

tokens.name: n-850
tokens.usage: Neutral step. A grey with a slight red bias (hue 25), so the neutrals belong to the seal. One scale serves both themes.

tokens.name: n-900
tokens.usage: Light theme ink and fog dots.

tokens.name: n-950
tokens.usage: Neutral step. A grey with a slight red bias (hue 25), so the neutrals belong to the seal. One scale serves both themes.

tokens.name: n-975
tokens.usage: Dark theme ground (bg).

tokens.name: rubedo
tokens.usage: The red of the seal, the alchemical rubedo. Lighter in dark so it holds 4.1:1 on n-975; 6.5:1 on n-100 in light.

tokens.name: rubedo-text
tokens.usage: Red for text: passages, hovered glosses. 7.1:1 on n-100 (light), 6.1:1 on n-975 (dark).

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The ground of every screen, under the fog.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and titles on bg. 15.6:1 light, 17.7:1 dark.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text, glosses, meta, tooltip text on bg. 5.2:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and the dotted ray only (1.6:1 / 1.5:1). Never the only sign of a control or a state.

tokens.name: fog
tokens.usage: The color of stipple cells (fog, simulacra), drawn at 55-72% over bg.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The seal, icons, focus rings, the tooltip hairline, the few accent cells of a simulacrum. Only moments of impact.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent for text on bg: the passage, a hovered gloss.

tokens.name: seal
tokens.usage: The φ mark. Always red, in both themes.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark and the home hero only. Red (seal), wght 400 = the φ stroke. Slant −12.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section titles (h1). Lowercase. clamp(44px, 8vw, 96px) on the site. Slant −12.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: the archive keeps what the fog would erase.
styles.usage: The one opening paragraph of a section.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: every text here is a draft that learned to stand.

styles.name: gloss
styles.usage: Latin and Greek glosses under section names, in ink-soft, slant −12. The home inscription: the English name in label, its gloss beneath in this style.

styles.name: gloss-title
styles.usage: The gloss above a section title.

spacing.note: Fibonacci steps of 4 px: each step is about φ times the one before, from step 3 on.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: caret margin, icon padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tooltip vertical padding, gaps between small controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Tooltip horizontal padding, gap from name to gloss.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a block.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between paragraphs and blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between whole sections of a long page.

radius.note: Nothing is rounded but the cursor. Shapes come from the brush, not from corners.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: panels, inputs, images, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-disc
tokens.usage: The cursor disc only.

duration.note: Motion is slow and settles; nothing bounces.

tokens.name: duration-quick
tokens.usage: Tooltip in and out, cursor fade.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Letter wave on hover.

tokens.name: duration-theme
tokens.usage: Theme change that nobody asked for (the system setting flips): the stipple's colours dissolve in soft patches.

tokens.name: duration-shift
tokens.usage: The eye's theme shift: the new ground seeps outward from the eye, cell by cell, while the page stays live.

tokens.name: duration-scene
tokens.usage: Sections entering (blur + rise). The seal travels in 1.6-1.8 s with minimum-jerk easing (JS).

tokens.name: duration-hush
tokens.usage: The ear: muting and unmuting the sound fade over this, never a cut.

tokens.name: duration-voice
tokens.usage: Sound: one screen's voice crossfading into the next on a route change.

tokens.name: easing-settle
tokens.usage: CSS transitions that arrive and settle. Anything that travels in JS uses Aphesis.MJ (minimum jerk).

tokens.name: z-fog
tokens.usage: The fog canvas.

tokens.name: z-ray
tokens.usage: The dotted ray from the seal to a focused name.

tokens.name: z-main
tokens.usage: Section content.

tokens.name: z-scroll
tokens.usage: The scroll disturbance (Aphesis.Scroll): on the content's layer, drawn after it, under the seal and the corners.

tokens.name: z-seal
tokens.usage: The φ seal.

tokens.name: z-corner
tokens.usage: Corner controls and the passage.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: The inscription of section names.

tokens.name: z-tip
tokens.usage: Tooltip.

tokens.name: z-cursor
tokens.usage: Cursor, above everything.

dataviz.note: The lab kit's data-viz tokens (system/lab-kit). Derived from the palette: the categorical hues share rubedo's discipline in OKLCH, the sequential ramp is the neutral scale, the diverging ramp runs lapis to rubedo through the grey of the ground. Checked by tools/lab-kit/build.py.

tokens.name: lab-cat-1
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 1, lapis. Series identity, assigned in this order and never cycled. At least 3:1 on bg in both themes.

tokens.name: lab-cat-2
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 2, ochre. Series identity, assigned in this order and never cycled. At least 3:1 on bg in both themes.

tokens.name: lab-cat-3
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 3, verdigris. Series identity, assigned in this order and never cycled. At least 3:1 on bg in both themes.

tokens.name: lab-cat-4
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 4, rosa. Series identity, assigned in this order and never cycled. At least 3:1 on bg in both themes.

tokens.name: lab-cat-5
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 5, umber. Series identity, assigned in this order and never cycled. At least 3:1 on bg in both themes.

tokens.name: lab-cat-6
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 6, caeruleum. Series identity, assigned in this order and never cycled. At least 3:1 on bg in both themes.

tokens.name: lab-cat-7
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 7, iosis. Series identity, assigned in this order and never cycled. At least 3:1 on bg in both themes.

tokens.name: lab-cat-8
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 8, olive. Series identity, assigned in this order and never cycled. At least 3:1 on bg in both themes.

tokens.name: lab-seq-1
tokens.usage: Sequential step 1 of 7 (magnitude, low to high): the density of ink, the stipple's own meaning. Step 1 sits near the ground.

tokens.name: lab-seq-2
tokens.usage: Sequential step 2 of 7 (magnitude, low to high): the density of ink, the stipple's own meaning. Step 1 sits near the ground.

tokens.name: lab-seq-3
tokens.usage: Sequential step 3 of 7 (magnitude, low to high): the density of ink, the stipple's own meaning. Step 1 sits near the ground.

tokens.name: lab-seq-4
tokens.usage: Sequential step 4 of 7 (magnitude, low to high): the density of ink, the stipple's own meaning. Step 1 sits near the ground.

tokens.name: lab-seq-5
tokens.usage: Sequential step 5 of 7 (magnitude, low to high): the density of ink, the stipple's own meaning. Step 1 sits near the ground.

tokens.name: lab-seq-6
tokens.usage: Sequential step 6 of 7 (magnitude, low to high): the density of ink, the stipple's own meaning. Step 1 sits near the ground.

tokens.name: lab-seq-7
tokens.usage: Sequential step 7 of 7 (magnitude, low to high): the density of ink, the stipple's own meaning. Step 1 sits near the ground.

tokens.name: lab-div-1
tokens.usage: Diverging step 1 of 7: lapis pole. Lapis below the baseline, rubedo above it (the side that asks for attention).

tokens.name: lab-div-2
tokens.usage: Diverging step 2 of 7: lapis. Lapis below the baseline, rubedo above it (the side that asks for attention).

tokens.name: lab-div-3
tokens.usage: Diverging step 3 of 7: lapis, near the middle. Lapis below the baseline, rubedo above it (the side that asks for attention).

tokens.name: lab-div-4
tokens.usage: Diverging step 4 of 7: the neutral middle (the baseline). Lapis below the baseline, rubedo above it (the side that asks for attention).

tokens.name: lab-div-5
tokens.usage: Diverging step 5 of 7: rubedo, near the middle. Lapis below the baseline, rubedo above it (the side that asks for attention).

tokens.name: lab-div-6
tokens.usage: Diverging step 6 of 7: rubedo. Lapis below the baseline, rubedo above it (the side that asks for attention).

tokens.name: lab-div-7
tokens.usage: Diverging step 7 of 7: rubedo pole. Lapis below the baseline, rubedo above it (the side that asks for attention).

tokens.name: lab-grid
tokens.usage: Gridlines: recessive, drawn as dotted square cells. Decorative only.

tokens.name: lab-axis
tokens.usage: Axis domain lines and ticks. Decorative: the tick labels carry the values.

tokens.name: lab-axis-text
tokens.usage: Tick labels, axis titles, legends, captions (5.2:1).

tokens.name: lab-mark
tokens.usage: A single series: ink, like the text. Categorical colours start at two series.

tokens.name: lab-dim
tokens.usage: Context marks behind the series that matter (unselected points, other runs).

tokens.name: lab-ref
tokens.usage: The one mark that matters: a threshold, the chosen point, the frontier's pick. Red is rare.

tokens.name: lab-pass
tokens.usage: Status text: passed, held, true (5.8:1 light, 9.3:1 dark). Always with its word.

tokens.name: lab-fail
tokens.usage: Status text: failed, broke, false. Always with its word.

size.name: lab-cell
size.usage: One stipple cell, always square: fog, bands, swatches, points.

size.name: lab-dot
size.usage: A scatter point (a square of 3 by 3 cells).

size.name: lab-point
size.usage: 3D point cloud: a point at rest, one cell.

size.name: lab-point-emph
size.usage: 3D point cloud: a point in a highlighted cluster.

size.name: lab-point-pick
size.usage: 3D point cloud: the picked point, in lab-ref.

size.name: lab-dim-alpha
size.usage: Opacity of context marks and unhighlighted points.

size.name: lab-fog-alpha
size.usage: Opacity of the stipple ground's cells over bg (the site draws 55 to 72%).

size.name: lab-band
size.usage: The receding band under a sticky header or over a sticky footer: what scrolls fades out across it (the site's bands: 30 to 80px).

size.name: lab-veil-blur
size.usage: The optional blur under a sticky header (.lab-header--blur): subtle, never on the stipple ground.
